TIMBER  v1.0.0
==============

A low-poly, first-person lumberjack and factory game.
Peel bark off trees with your bare hands, sell it, buy better tools, and work your way up to
sawmills, smelters, conveyor belts, logic circuits, mine carts on rails and flying drones.
There is no inventory: everything is a physics object you pick up and carry.

CONTROLS
  Mouse ............ look
  W A S D .......... walk            Shift ... run        Space ... jump
  Left click ....... use your tool (chop, saw, mine, build, place wires...)
  E or right click . pick up / drop / use the thing you're looking at
  R ................ turn the build you're placing, tip over what you hold, turn a rail
  X (hammer) ....... take a build down (you get its value back)
  Q ................ put your tool down
  1-9 / scroll ..... switch tools (Shift+1-9 for tools 10-18)
  Tab .............. phone (once you've bought one)
  F11 .............. fullscreen
  Esc .............. pause and settings

GETTING STARTED
  Follow the short tutorial in the top-left corner: take the hatchet from the chopping block,
  strip some bark, put it on the green truck and ship it. The computer in the cabin is your shop.

SAVING
  The game saves by itself. "Continue" on the title screen picks up where you left off.
  In the browser version your save lives in the browser; clearing site data deletes it.
